source: entry headings of the initial NanoLex files (Data/*.md), a model-written lexicon from 2024-2025
membership: every entry heading; definitions, classifications and relations are not read
cleaning: cut at literal \n and '#'; plain hyphen for mis-encoded and typographic dashes; drop repeated 'Lexical Dictionary' text, '(n.)' markers, IPA parentheticals, wrapping quotes and trailing ':' or '.'; merge forms that differ only in case, quotes, trade-mark signs or spacing. Hyphen, slash and spacing-of-words variants stay separate seeds.
